- A lease row left behind by an expired or released lease must not block the next claimant: the next claim mints a strictly greater epoch and that epoch validates on every fenced mutation.
- No new enforcement in this child - the gated surfaces come from s1, s2, and s3. This child is the compatibility and non-regression proof for them.

Acceptance:

- After release and reclaim, the new epoch validates on each fenced surface while the superseded one is rejected with exit code 4.
- Old lease rows surviving in the store do not prevent a later valid epoch from mutating the issue.
- Coverage lives with the existing claim-epoch tests and runs in the default suite.
- cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, and cargo test pass.
issue.title: Keep unclaimed-issue mutations credential-free and historical lease rows compatible
